history.sprint: Sprint v1.4 — First Real Material Workflow
history.summary: Adopted the offline-generator resolution proposed for v1.3's conflict (1); built Module A docs/TeachingMaterials/scripts/GenerateTeachingMaterialData.js (Node, scans Repository, converts via the unmodified TeachingMaterialAdapter, writes js/data/TeachingMaterialData.js — a static, <script>-tagged data file, same convention as MockData.js; skips any Package failing ValidateMaterial.js rather than inlining it) and Module B js/runtime/TeachingMaterialLoader.js (browser coordinator, no material-content store of its own, same pattern as ImportRuntime.js; AHS.TeachingMaterialLoader.initialize() calls only existing MaterialRuntime.add()/SummaryRuntime.add()/QuestionRuntime.importQuestions()). Module C wired initialize() into js/pages/AppMaterials.js + AppQuiz.js bootstrap, plus 2 <script> tags each on materials.html/quiz.html. Modules D/E (Material Center/Summary) needed zero code changes — both already read exclusively via existing Runtime query APIs. Real architectural finding made and solved while building Module F (Practice): MaterialRuntime/SummaryRuntime rehydrate from sessionStorage on every page reload (this is a multi-page app, not an SPA) while QuestionRuntime is intentionally memory-only and isn't even <script>-tagged on materials.html — a naive Loader would either duplicate Material/Summary records on revisit or never reach QuestionRuntime on quiz.html at all. Fixed by persisting a small Package-id -> Runtime-id map (via the existing PersistenceAdapter) for Material/Summary idempotency, while deliberately re-running QuestionRuntime import on every page load where that Runtime exists. Second finding, disclosed not hidden: this app's own pre-existing '不得混用' design keeps '練習模式' (LearningQuestionRuntime) and Exam Mode (QuestionRuntime) strictly separate, and Exam Mode's session list is a fixed catalog (ExamData.js) with no dynamic entry point — so Teaching Material questions are genuinely stored/queryable in QuestionRuntime but have no live UI button reaching them yet, the same disclosed-gap pattern ImportRuntime.js already established. Verified via a realistic 3-page Node vm simulation (first visit / revisit — no duplicate / quiz.html without MaterialRuntime.js loaded — id correctly resolved via the persisted map) using scratch Package tm_997, deleted immediately after; js/data/TeachingMaterialData.js regenerated back to [] against the real, still-empty Repository before committing. npm run verify + npm test (175/175 + 6/6, including real jsdom loads of materials.html/quiz.html with 0 console errors) both clean. See docs/EO/Sprint_v1.4_FirstRealMaterialWorkflow_Report.md.

history.sprint: HOTFIX-004 — Review Suggestion & Quiz Runtime Integration
history.summary: Follow-up PAT after HOTFIX-003: Summary Center's ⑤ 複習建議 always showed 尚無資料, and Quiz Center's pre-existing 開始 AI 練習 link (quiz.html?mode=practice&materialId=..., Sprint 6.8, unrelated to Sprint v1.6's own new examId link) landed on 巧巧老師出題引導/LearningQuestionRuntime, honestly empty for Repository-sourced materials since that Runtime's completeness gate needs a knowledgeId/learningObjective no Repository record has. Issue 001 fixed by adding deriveReviewSuggestions() directly inside js/components/SummaryCenter.js — used only when record.reviewSuggestions is genuinely empty, computed entirely from fields the SummaryRuntime record already has (chapter/section/coreConcepts/memorize/pitfalls, all real HOTFIX-002 data) — no new file, no new Repository lookup, never written back into SummaryRuntime (which has no update-in-place API anyway). Issue 002 fixed in js/components/QuizCenter.js via a new resolveDirectExamId(): derives teaching_material_<materialId> and checks QuestionRuntime.hasExam() when only initialMaterialId is given (no explicit examId), routing into the same, already-built, unmodified ExamRuntime.startFromExam() (Sprint v1.6) — so both the pre-existing materialId-only link and the new examId link now land on the same real questions. Also fixed a real double-render bug found in the same investigation: Sprint v1.6's own examId link sets mode=practice too, and startOnPractice never considered examId, so a Repository-sourced material's real Exam view and an unrelated empty Practice Mode section could both render at once — practiceRoot now stays hidden whenever a direct exam id resolves. Added 難度/考點 display to js/ui/QuestionCard.js: knowledgePoint was already present on the stored question; difficulty never survived into QuestionRuntime's stored shape (TeachingMaterialLoader.js, protected this Hotfix, never carried it) so it's resolved instead via HOTFIX-003's already-built, read-only MaterialDetailRepositorySource.js (extended with a purely additive id field on its quiz mapping, not changing Material Detail's own rendering at all). Zero protected files touched: MaterialRuntime/SummaryRuntime/WrongBookRuntime/HistoryRuntime/MaterialCard/Material Detail's own components (MaterialContentView/MaterialSummaryCard/MaterialQuestionCard/AIGatewayPanel/MaterialPreview)/TeachingMaterialLoader/both Repository schemas all confirmed byte-identical. Verified against the real Civics material via jsdom across both entry points (real reviewSuggestions text, real questions, no double-render, real 難度/考點) plus the full PAT chain (AutoGrader -> WrongBook -> History, one deliberately wrong answer), and confirmed regular (non-Repository) materials' honest empty states on both Summary and Quiz Guide are completely unaffected. Added a new regression-test group ([26] in BehaviorSuite.js, 17 checks). npm run verify + npm test (211/211, up from 194, coverage increased not decreased) + 6/6 PipelineRegression all clean. PR not merged — awaiting Project Owner PAT, per this Hotfix's own explicit instruction. See docs/EO/HOTFIX-004_Review_Quiz_Runtime_Report.md.
